title: Janus_Time
purpose: Единый proof-aware свод JANUS о времени: физика, математика, метрология, вычислительные системы, биология, восприятие, философия и спекулятивные модели. Исходный материал сохранён внутри артефакта без потерь.

rules: Не называть математическую модель физическим фактом без отдельного эмпирического основания.
Не превращать характерный масштаб в доказанный минимальный квант.
Не смешивать coordinate time, proper time, civil time, logical time и perceived time.
Формула всегда хранится вместе с областью применимости и ограничениями.
Спекулятивные конструкции сохраняются, но не повышаются до закона природы.
Никакой heuristics-as-evidence: приближения допустимы только с явно указанными условиями и погрешностью.

executive_model.statement: В современной физике нет одного универсального 'механизма времени'. Есть согласованные структуры: порядок событий, измеряемые длительности часов, собственное время мировых линий, координатное время в выбранной системе, причинная структура пространства-времени и статистическая стрела времени. Психологическое и гражданское время — отдельные прикладные слои.

si_second.definition: The second, symbol s, is defined by fixing the numerical value of the unperturbed ground-state hyperfine transition frequency of 133Cs, ΔνCs, to exactly 9 192 631 770 Hz.

redefinition_2026_status.statement: Оптические стандарты превзошли лучшие цезиевые реализации по систематической неопределённости и стабильности; BIPM/CCTF ведёт roadmap к возможному переопределению секунды. BIPM указывает возможный 2030 год, но на 2026-09-14 новое определение ещё не ратифицировано.

TAI.meaning: International Atomic Time; continuous atomic timescale produced by BIPM.

UTC.meaning: same rate as TAI; offset by an integral number of seconds under current leap-second regime

UT1.meaning: Earth-rotation angle based time; non-uniform relative to atomic time.

TDB.meaning: barycentric dynamical time; conventional scale related to TCB/TT

GPS.relation: GPS time = TAI - 19 s; no leap seconds

Unix_POSIX.caveat: POSIX timestamps do not provide a one-to-one representation of leap seconds; treating Unix time as simply 'UTC seconds including leap seconds' is wrong.

policy_transition.statement: CGPM Resolution 4 (2022) decides that the maximum allowed |UT1-UTC| will be increased in or before 2035, changing the present leap-second regime.

clock_characterization.phase_noise: clock phase/frequency fluctuations require noise-type-specific statistics; one scalar 'drift' is insufficient
clock_characterization.traceability: primary realization -> transfer/comparison -> secondary/working standards -> field instrument, with uncertainty budget

affine_time_model.instant_space: an affine line A modeled on a one-dimensional vector space V of durations
affine_time_model.warning: T ≅ R is a very useful continuum model, not an experimentally established axiom that microscopic time must literally be the real line.

order_and_intervals.total_order: ordinary one-dimensional coordinate time can be totally ordered
order_and_intervals.causal_order: spacetime events instead have a Lorentzian causal partial order; spacelike separated events have no invariant before/after ordering

analysis.fourier: F(omega)=integral f(t) exp(-i omega t) dt

temporal_logic.CTL: branching-time path quantifiers A/E combined with temporal operators
temporal_logic.timed_automata: clocks are real-valued variables with guards and resets

classical_dynamics.newton: F=dp/dt; for constant mass, F=m a
classical_dynamics.noether: continuous differentiable symmetry of the action implies a conserved current/quantity under the theorem's assumptions

postulates: local laws of physics are Lorentz covariant
special_relativity.proper_time: d tau = sqrt(1-v^2/c^2) dt for inertial coordinates in flat spacetime
special_relativity.simultaneity: spacelike simultaneity is frame-dependent; causal ordering of timelike/lightlike related events is invariant

general_relativity.proper_time: d tau=(1/c)*sqrt(-g_mu_nu dx^mu dx^nu) for signature (-,+,+,+) on timelike paths
general_relativity.schwarzschild_stationary_clock: d tau = dt*sqrt(1-2GM/(r c^2)) for a static observer outside a nonrotating spherical mass in Schwarzschild coordinates
general_relativity.scope_warning: the simple Schwarzschild factor is not the general gravitational time-dilation formula

gnss_example.statement: GNSS must include both special- and general-relativistic clock-rate corrections; for GPS the familiar net pre-launch frequency correction corresponds to roughly +38 microseconds/day of satellite-clock advance relative to clocks on the geoid before system-specific steering/corrections.

thermodynamic_arrow.second_law: For an isolated macroscopic system, thermodynamic entropy does not decrease in the ideal thermodynamic description: Delta S >= 0.
thermodynamic_arrow.statistical_caveat: microscopic dynamics can be reversible while coarse-grained macroscopic entropy shows an overwhelmingly probable arrow; finite systems can exhibit fluctuations

landauer.formula: Q >= k_B T ln 2 per logically irreversible bit erasure in the ideal limit
landauer.caveat: not every computation step necessarily dissipates this amount; reversible computation can in principle avoid logical erasure cost

quantum_time.unitary_evolution: U(t)=exp(-i H t/hbar) for time-independent H in a closed system

energy_time_uncertainty.statement: There is no single universal operator uncertainty relation Delta E Delta t >= hbar/2 analogous to position-momentum, because time is normally a parameter in standard nonrelativistic QM. Several distinct energy-time relations exist (lifetime-linewidth, Mandelstam-Tamm, etc.).
energy_time_uncertainty.mandelstam_tamm: tau_A * Delta H >= hbar/2 with tau_A=Delta A/|d<A>/dt| under stated conditions

planck_time.rejection: The source claim 'Delta t >= t_P' is not an established law and is rejected as stated.

quantum_gravity_and_fundamental_time.wheeler_dewitt: H_hat Psi = 0 in canonical quantum gravity formulations; motivates the 'problem of time'

approaches.name: loop_quantum_gravity
approaches.idea: quantized geometric operators; temporal discreteness is not simply established as a universal tick

approaches.name: string_theory
approaches.idea: time remains embedded in higher-dimensional quantum/gravitational frameworks; no experimentally confirmed string-time microstructure

approaches.name: holography_AdS_CFT
approaches.idea: bulk gravitational theory can be dual to boundary QFT in specific settings

quantum_gravity_and_fundamental_time.core_open_question: Is time fundamental, emergent, relational, or a derived parameter in quantum gravity? No experimentally confirmed answer exists.

cosmology.cosmic_time: in homogeneous-isotropic FLRW coordinates, t is proper time of ideal comoving observers
cosmology.age: t0=integral_0^1 da/(a H(a)) within a specified cosmological model
cosmology.arrow_open_issue: The low-entropy boundary condition of the early universe is central to explanations of the thermodynamic arrow and remains a foundational question.

causality_and_time_travel.causal_cones: local light cones define which events can influence which others in Lorentzian spacetime

examples: certain wormhole constructions under idealized assumptions
closed_timelike_curves.empirical: No empirical evidence for physically usable closed timelike curves or macroscopic travel to the past.

wormholes.note: Traversable wormhole solutions generally require severe stress-energy/exotic-matter conditions; physical realizability is unknown.

novikov.meaning: self-consistency principle for histories with CTCs; not a law of nature

chronology_protection.meaning: Hawking's proposal that quantum effects prevent macroscopic chronology violation; not proven

many_worlds_escape.note: Branching-world resolutions are not experimentally established time-travel mechanisms.

clocks_and_frequency_engineering.clock_abstraction: oscillator + discriminator/reference + feedback/servo + phase/frequency accumulator + readout
clocks_and_frequency_engineering.pll: f_out = N*f_ref only for an ideal integer-N locked steady state; real PLL dynamics require loop transfer functions
clocks_and_frequency_engineering.dds: f_out = f_clk*M/2^N for an ideal phase accumulator with tuning word M and N-bit accumulator

sampling.nyquist_shannon: band-limited signal with maximum frequency B can be perfectly reconstructed from ideal samples if f_s>2B under theorem assumptions

physical_clocks: CLOCK_REALTIME for civil timestamps and subject to adjustment
distributed_and_computational_time.warning: A call to now() is not mathematically deterministic with respect to program inputs alone; it samples external state. Deterministic replay requires captured timestamps or a virtual clock.

lamport.rule: C:=C+1 before local/send event; on receive C:=max(C_local,C_msg)+1
lamport.guarantee: a -> b implies L(a)<L(b); converse does not hold

vector_clocks.order: V(a)<=V(b) componentwise and V(a)!=V(b) implies causal precedence under the vector-clock model
vector_clocks.concurrency: incomparable vectors indicate no captured happens-before relation

hybrid_logical_clocks.idea: combine bounded physical time with logical counter to preserve causality and useful wall-time proximity

ntp_four_timestamp.caveat: offset estimate assumes path-delay model; epsilon is not simply RTT/2 as an equality

distributed_and_computational_time.ptp: IEEE 1588 family can use hardware timestamps for sub-microsecond or better synchronization depending on profile/network/hardware

truetime.concept: returns an uncertainty interval [earliest,latest] rather than pretending a perfectly known global instant
truetime.warning: a fixed <=7 ms bound is not a universal law and must not be frozen as such

stream_processing.watermark: monotone estimate/contract about completeness of event-time progress; heuristic watermarks must be labeled heuristic

real_time_scheduling.task_model: tau_i=(C_i,T_i,D_i) execution cost, period/min inter-arrival, deadline
real_time_scheduling.edf_uniprocessor_ideal: for independent preemptible periodic tasks with D_i=T_i and usual assumptions, U<=1 is the classic feasibility bound
real_time_scheduling.rate_monotonic_sufficient_bound: U <= n(2^(1/n)-1) under Liu-Layland assumptions; sufficient, not necessary

stochastic_and_statistical_time.poisson_process: P(N(t)=k)=exp(-lambda t)(lambda t)^k/k! for homogeneous Poisson process
stochastic_and_statistical_time.brownian: dX=mu dt+sigma dW is an Ito diffusion model, not deterministic mechanics
stochastic_and_statistical_time.epistemic_note: The source's blanket 'no probabilistic estimation' rule conflicts with real stochastic physics/engineering. JANUS instead forbids unlabeled guesswork, not probability theory.

pharmacokinetics.warning: 'steady state after 5 half-lives' is a rule of thumb, not exact universal law

chronobiology.circadian: endogenous near-24-h oscillations entrained by zeitgebers
chronobiology.human_free_running: approximately but not exactly 24 h; values are population/protocol dependent

human_perception_and_cognition.distinction: subjective duration is not a physical clock reading and changes with attention, arousal, memory, modality and task design
human_perception_and_cognition.rejected_as_axiom: A universal 2-3 s 'specious present' is not a fundamental law; reported integration windows are task- and definition-dependent.

applied_time_domains.note: These are frameworks for description/organization and must not be promoted to physical laws.

control: PID: u=Kp e + Ki integral e dt + Kd de/dt
continuous LTI transfer G(s)=Y(s)/U(s) under zero initial conditions
queueing: Little: L=lambda W under steady-state conservation assumptions
information: Shannon entropy H(X)=-sum p log2 p
AWGN capacity C=B log2(1+S/N) under Shannon-Hartley assumptions
radiometric_dating: t=(1/lambda) ln(N0/N) when initial/closed-system assumptions are satisfied

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: T is physically proven to be isomorphic to R
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: R is a continuum model for time coordinates; fundamental temporal microstructure remains open.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: Delta t >= t_P
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: Planck time is a natural scale built from hbar,G,c; no universal minimum time interval is experimentally established.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: Delta E Delta t >= hbar/2 is the same kind of operator uncertainty as x-p
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: energy-time uncertainty has several context-specific formulations; standard QM usually treats time as a parameter.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: cause <= effect in the same inertial frame is the causal axiom
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: causality is encoded by invariant light-cone structure; spacelike order can reverse between frames.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: entropy always non-decreasing microscopically
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: second-law monotonicity is thermodynamic/statistical with scope; microscopic dynamics and fluctuations require nuance.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: all operations deterministic and pure
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: mathematical transformations can be pure; physical measurement, stochastic models, distributed systems and quantum outcomes need explicit state/probability semantics.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: no randomness or fixed seed is a law of time
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: reproducibility policy may fix pseudo-random seeds, but nature/model uncertainty is not thereby deterministic.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: full determinism: no hidden variables
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: Bell experiments constrain local hidden-variable theories; they do not establish a JANUS axiom of classical determinism.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: holography bulk iff boundary universally
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: well-defined dualities such as AdS/CFT are powerful framework-specific correspondences; universal applicability is not established.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: cosmic censorship/no naked singularities is a law
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: cosmic censorship exists in weak/strong conjectural forms and is not proven generally.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: Novikov self-consistency is a law
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: a proposed consistency principle for CTC scenarios.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: Moore law of clock drift
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: linear clock model x(t)=x0+y0 t is a simple drift approximation; there is no standard 'Moore law' of clock drift.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: Bradley law interpolation
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: the displayed expansion was a Taylor-series approximation, not a standard Bradley law.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: UTC/Unix includes leap seconds one-for-one
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: UTC has leap seconds under the current regime; POSIX/Unix timestamp semantics generally do not uniquely count/encode them.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: epsilon=RTT/2 gives exact network clock synchronization error
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: RTT constrains delay only under assumptions; asymmetry and timestamping uncertainty matter.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: a fixed TrueTime <=7 ms is universal
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: TrueTime uncertainty is deployment- and time-dependent; the important abstraction is an uncertainty interval.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: monogamy formula E(A:BC)>=E(A:B)+E(A:C) universally
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: monogamy inequalities depend on entanglement measure, state class and powers; no single displayed form is universal.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: Church-Turing means all computational models are physically equivalent
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: the Church-Turing thesis concerns effectively calculable functions; complexity and physical realizability are separate questions.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: CAP: C and A imply not P as an unconditional algebraic theorem
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: CAP concerns tradeoffs during network partitions under specific distributed-system definitions.

epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.claim: FLP means consensus is impossible in every asynchronous system
epistemic_corrections_to_legacy_source.replacement: FLP proves deterministic consensus cannot guarantee termination in a fully asynchronous message-passing system with even one crash failure, under its assumptions.

open_questions.question: Is temporal passage fundamental or an emergent feature of records/entropy/observers?
What replaces classical spacetime/time at the quantum-gravity scale?
Why did the observable universe begin in such a low-entropy macrostate?
Can a satisfactory quantum theory of clocks define operational time without an external classical parameter?
Are physically realizable CTCs excluded by quantum gravity/chronology protection?
Which optical transition/combination, if any, will define the future SI second?
How should UTC operate after the planned increase of the allowed UT1-UTC difference by or before 2035?

update_gates.metrology_gate: On every major Janus_Time revision, check BIPM CCTF/CGPM for SI-second redefinition status.
update_gates.utc_gate: Check latest IERS Bulletin C and CGPM/ITU implementation decisions before changing UTC/leap-second claims.
update_gates.physics_gate: New fundamental-time claims require peer-reviewed/authoritative evidence and must enter as OPEN/HYPOTHESIS until independently supported.
update_gates.formula_gate: Every formula addition must include domain, assumptions, dimensions/units where applicable, and a test case or reference.
update_gates.speculation_gate: Time travel, CTC engineering, wormholes and emergent-time proposals may be stored, but cannot be promoted above their evidence status.

canonical_verdict.what_we_can_say: Time is operationally measurable by clocks and structurally embedded in our best theories, but its deepest ontological status is not settled. Relativity establishes non-universal simultaneity and path-dependent proper time; thermodynamics supplies a statistical arrow; quantum theory uses time differently from position; quantum gravity leaves the deepest layer open.
canonical_verdict.what_we_cannot_say: We do not know that time has a smallest tick, that the universe is fundamentally deterministic, that usable time travel exists, or that any one philosophical interpretation is experimentally established.
